text:
A washbasin has an exit pipe covered with a plug of area 12cm2. A chain is attached to the
centre of the plug to assist in pulling the plug away from the exit hole. The washbasin contains
water to a depth of 0.080m.
The density of the water is 1000kg/m3.
chain
plug
What is the force acting on the plug due to the water?
A
0.96N
B
800N
C
9600N
D
80000N
subject: Physics
